items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I used to sit in with him... I used to play gigs with him... then I played with Tiny about six months in the club there.

ctx.x: Yeah. Tiny Parham -- I used to sit in with him. Big guy had a band -- a big fat guy, Tiny Parham. He's an arranger. I used to play gigs with him, you know. Any body had a gig you played that night. Now, I didn't play regular with nobody but anybody had a gig you just play with them, you know. Make a couple of bucks, you know.
I saw in Chilton that during that period you worked with them and they also mentioned Roy Eldridge.
